Brokild VR · mixed reality

Tank Ambush

Small tanks roll into your own room. They hide behind your sofa, peek round the corner of your desk — the front of the hull appears first — and shoot glowing shells at your headset. You have a homing rocket launcher in each hand. Duck behind something solid and they cannot hit you.

Checking for WebXR…

How it plays

  • Trigger fires a rocket from that hand. Its motor burns for a second, then it coasts and drops. The seeker only nudges it toward a tank inside the red ring — aim well, and aim a little high at long range.
  • A direct hit destroys a tank. A rocket that goes off close by shoves it sideways and damages it: it drives slower from then on.
  • Tanks shoot at your headset, but only with a clear line of sight. Walk, lean and duck — or hide behind real furniture.
  • The health bar is on the back of each launcher. At zero it is game over. Clearing a wave gives a little health back.
  • Grip button shows the scanned room mesh (cyan wireframe) so you can see what the tanks treat as walls.

Before you start

HeadsetMeta Quest 3 or Quest 3S, Meta Browser, passthrough on.
Room scanQuest Settings → Environment → Space Setup. Without a scan the game puts a few virtual barriers around you instead.
SpaceClear about 2 × 2 m. You will dodge. Mind your furniture and the Guardian.
PermissionThe browser may ask to access your room geometry — say yes, that is the scan.

Flat preview

On a computer: click the view to capture the mouse (or just hold the button and drag to look), WASD to move, mouse to aim, click to fire (the hands alternate), G for the room mesh.
